info.title: build
info.description: Builds a .NET repo through MSBuild's static graph with a relocatable output cache on local disk and Google Cloud Storage.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Restore and build a solution through the cache.

options.name: --cache
options.description: A local store directory, ~/.mida/cache by default, or gs://<bucket>[/<prefix>] for a GCS store behind it.

options.name: --read-only
options.description: Store nothing in either store. [default: False]

options.name: --evaluate
options.description: Restore and evaluate every project, even when the store holds a graph that fits. No graph is stored either. [default: False]

options.name: --print-keys
options.description: Print each project's cache key. [default: False]

options.name: --key-details
options.description: Write the lines of each key to this directory.

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: The .sln or .slnx to build. Defaults to the only one in the current directory.
